title: National Adaptation Plan for the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago
organization: Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago, Ministry of Planning and Development
temporal_coverage: Government's first NAP, November 2023; sector risk assessments include next-ten-year likelihood judgments.
methodology: Government-led, multi-year plan with stakeholder input and sector technical-working-group risk assessments.
limitations: Local risk levels are plan-era assessments, not measured outcomes; scenario detail varies by table.

title: Forecasting Trinidad's Evolving Flood Future: A Susceptibility Mapping Approach with Long-Term Rainfall Projections (2010-2100)
organization: ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences
temporal_coverage: Peer-reviewed 2026 study combines historical rainfall and projected rainfall layers to map Trinidad flood susceptibility at five-year intervals through 2100.
methodology: GIS weighted-overlay susceptibility model combines rainfall, elevation, slope, road and drainage density, and locally derived land cover.
limitations: Model uses 2007 land cover and equal factor weights, downscales coarse rainfall data, and lacks independent validation; susceptibility is not event probability.

title: Commonwealth Caribbean Cities, Climate Change Adaptation and Resilience: Empowering Local Government
organization: Commonwealth Journal of Local Governance, University of Technology Sydney
temporal_coverage: Peer-reviewed article published October 2024; Trinidad case evidence includes 2023 interviews and earlier planning documents.
methodology: Comparative case study uses a 2022 workshop, 2023 interviews, legislation, policy documents and literature.
limitations: Trinidad findings include two participant perspectives, not a representative survey; some context is attributed to earlier literature.

title: Written submission by the Ministry of Rural Development and Local Government to the Joint Select Committee on Land and Physical Infrastructure: Climate Change Inquiry
organization: Ministry of Rural Development and Local Government, Trinidad and Tobago
temporal_coverage: Ministry response submitted March 2023; training counts and implementation descriptions are dated to 2021-2023.
methodology: Ministry's parliamentary written response on climate impacts, municipal disaster management and adaptation.
limitations: Government self-report, not an independent evaluation; stated programme status is dated and was not reverified for 2026.

title: Multi-sectoral Adaptation Measures to Flood Relief in the South Oropouche River Basin Project
organization: Environmental Policy and Planning Division, Government of Trinidad and Tobago
temporal_coverage: Government page describes the project's September 2023 launch, design targets and four-year implementation period.
methodology: Government page reports project launch, targets and partner statements.
limitations: Launch-stage aims and targets are not audited outcomes or final results.
